title: Explicit splitting data, splitting presieve, and local sum
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $T\to X$ an object of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. A splitting is a finite type $J$, schemes $V_j$, a clopen coproduct cofan $i_j:V_j\to T\times_XY$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], and inverse projections $t_j:T\to V_j$, with $t_ji_jp=1$ and $i_jpt_j=1$. The split presieve on $W$ consists of all arrows $T\to W$ with some such splitting. For etale $f$ the sheet section is $t_ji_j:T\to B_fT$, and for an abelian sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] the splitting sum on $s\in F(B_fT)$ is $\sum_jF(t_ji_j)s$. Empty $J$ is allowed. All data are explicit constructor inputs.
